title: Qaṭr al-nadā: the step after the Ājurrūmiyya
summary: Ibn Hishām's intermediate naḥw, longer than al-Ājurrūmiyya and shorter than the Alfiyya.

sections.heading: The book
paragraphs: Qaṭr al-nadā wa-ball al-ṣadā, the drop of dew that quenches the thirsty, is the first of Ibn Hishām's graded books, followed by Shudhūr al-dhahab, Awḍaḥ al-masālik and Mughnī al-labīb. Ibn Hishām wrote his own commentary on it.
It is the usual second book of naḥw at al-Azhar and in Arab study circles, and an English translation appeared in 2024.
